nav.label: Coach sign-up steps
nav.title: Coach sign-up
nav.note: Saved as you go · finish later from any device.

loadFailure.title: We couldn’t load your coach profile.
loadFailure.body: Check your connection and try again.

failure.finish: We couldn’t finish your coach sign-up.
failure.typed: Check your connection. Nothing you typed is lost.
failure.selected: Check your connection. Your choices are kept.

invalid.title: Check the highlighted fields.
invalid.body: Fix them to save this step.

rejected.title: Your coach profile is missing details.

account.title: Finish your account basics first.
account.body: Your name, date of birth and agreements come before your coach profile.

profile.title: Your coach profile
profile.lead: How fighters will recognise you as a coach. Coach name, country and city are required.

name.label: Coach name
name.help: Shown to fighters. Up to 60 characters.
name.suggested: Suggested from your account name. Change it if you coach under another name.

brand.label: Brand name · optional
brand.help: Your coaching business, if you use one. Up to 80 characters.

country.label: Country
country.help: Search the list. Stored as the ISO country code.

bio.label: Bio · optional
bio.placeholder: What you coach and how you work.

type.title: How do you coach?
type.lead: Pick every format you offer. You can change this later.

levels.label: Competition level · optional
levels.help: The fighters you prepare for bouts.

preview.title: Coach preview
preview.name: Your coach name
preview.separate: Your coach profile is separate from your account name and from a fighter profile.

done.title: Your coach profile is ready.
done.lead: It is saved to your account and you can change it later. Any fighter profile you have stays as it is.
done.pendingTitle: Coach tools are not available yet.
done.pendingBody: Your coach home shows what is planned. Your profile is ready for it.
done.failureTitle: We couldn’t open your coach home.
done.failureBody: Your coach profile is saved. Try again.

errors.invalidFormat: Remove line breaks and other hidden characters.
